data.title: Route Overview
paragraphs: The Nilgiris and Mysuru sit close on the map but feel dramatically different. Begin among tea slopes, shola fragments, old hill-station architecture, and the mountain railway before descending through forest corridors toward Karnataka’s royal plain.

Mysuru then changes the scale again through palace architecture, markets, craft, food, and the Kaveri river landscape around Srirangapatna. The journey is designed so the forest crossing becomes a transition rather than simply a transfer.

introParagraphs: This 9-day journey is paced around meaningful stays, sensible road movement, and enough time in each landscape to understand it rather than simply pass through.

data.title: RAIL & FOREST NOTE
data.text: Nilgiri Mountain Railway seats are subject to schedule and availability. Forest transit is kept to legal daylight windows, and wildlife sightings are never guaranteed.

data.title: From Blue Hills to Royal Gold
paragraphs: The route works because the landscapes do the storytelling. The Nilgiris provide altitude and cool light; the forest corridor provides transition; Mysuru brings ceremony, craft, and urban grace.
Instead of treating Ooty and Mysuru as separate destinations, the journey reveals the ecological and historical continuity between them.

items.question: Can this route be tailored to our preferred dates and pace?
paragraphs: Yes. Every Signature itinerary is a design framework, and we adjust nights, experiences, transport, and daily intensity around your interests and travel dates.

items.question: Is the Nilgiri Mountain Railway guaranteed?
paragraphs: No. We plan around availability and can substitute a scenic road segment without weakening the journey.

items.question: Will we do a wildlife safari?
paragraphs: A safari can be added, but the core route does not depend on sightings or a fixed game-drive programme.

items.question: Can Mysuru be extended?
paragraphs: Yes. Extra nights work well for craft, yoga, food, or a slower palace-and-market programme.

items.question: What is included when the final journey is quoted?
paragraphs: The final proposal clearly separates accommodation, private transport, guiding, arranged experiences, and any route-specific permits or specialist access.
items.listTitle: The exact inclusion list is confirmed before payment:
listItems: Chosen accommodation category and meal plan.
Confirmed guiding, hosted encounters, and ticketed experiences.
Any permits or special-access costs included in the final design.

items.question: How are reservations confirmed and scheduled?
paragraphs: Once the bespoke route, accommodation selection, and current supplier availability are approved, a 30% confirmation deposit secures the agreed services. The remaining balance is due 45 days before arrival unless the final proposal states otherwise.

items.question: What is the policy for date changes or cancellations?
paragraphs: We work directly with our partners to move dates whenever possible. Any non-refundable permits, transport tickets, or supplier penalties are passed through transparently.
listItems: 60+ days before arrival: deposit refund less confirmed non-refundable costs.
30–59 days before arrival: 50% refund or travel credit where supplier terms allow.
Less than 30 days before arrival: cancellation follows the confirmed supplier terms in your final proposal.
